mentions.name: Kan
mentions.description: Kan is an offline Kanban board that operates on plain text files stored in a repository, so the entire board can be committed to Git. It includes a CLI that AI agents use well for tracking and managing work, and the author uses it for all their projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing to work on Kan, an offline Kanban board which operates on plain text files in your repo, so you can just commit the entire board into Git!
